sentences.text: In 1858, France and Spain sent warships to the coast of Vietnam.
On 31 August, the fleet arrived off Đà Nẵng, a wide, deep harbour not far from the capital, Huế.
The next morning, 1 September, the ships opened fire on the forts at the river mouth and on the Sơn Trà peninsula.
Within two days the first forts were in the invaders' hands.
The invaders had planned a quick advance to Huế.
Vietnamese forces, led by the commander Nguyễn Tri Phương, built defensive lines and kept the enemy close to the coast for months.
In February 1859 the main French force sailed south toward Sài Gòn instead.
This was the beginning of French colonial conquest, long before the resistance of 1945–1954.
